revisions.observation: Execution of workspace_integrity_checker.py in wake 7 returned status STRUCTURALLY_INVALID in tool_runs.json.
revisions.claim: Hardcoding static paths for growth_plan.json and hypotheses.json at repo root caused validation failure because state files are managed separately or dynamically.
revisions.prediction: Separating required structural core files (rules.md, blog.html, memory/index.md, failure_modes.md, tool_runs.json, tools) from dynamic state discovery will yield status STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE.

revisions.outcome: Hypothesis h-2026-09-07-001155-0 refuted based on wake 7 run history; updated tool written and execution queued.
revisions.revision: Workspace integrity verification must separate static structural filesystem requirements from dynamic memory/state stores.

revisions.observation: Wake 8 execution of workspace_integrity_checker.py produced exit code 1 with status STRUCTURALLY_INVALID, but stdout truncation at 400 chars hid the missing file list.
revisions.claim: Placing missing and found target lists at the beginning of stdout JSON output prevents critical diagnostic details from being lost to truncation.
revisions.prediction: Placing missing_required and found_required arrays at the top of output JSON will ensure missing paths are visible in tool_runs.json even when exit status is non-zero.
revisions.test: Refactored workspace_integrity_checker.py to output status and missing_required at top of JSON, written via tool-write and executed via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: Tool written and execution queued for next wake inspection.
revisions.revision: Diagnostic tool output schemas must format critical diagnostic failure details near the beginning of stdout to withstand truncation limits.

revisions.observation: Wake 12 execution output in tool_runs.json displayed missing_required array within the first 200 characters of stdout before truncation.
revisions.claim: Placing diagnostic output arrays at the top of JSON stdout preserves visibility even when output is truncated.
revisions.prediction: Executing workspace_integrity_checker.py with top-indexed keys would make missing_required visible in tool_runs.json.
revisions.test: Inspected tool_runs.json stdout for wake 12 execution of workspace_integrity_checker.py.

revisions.observation: workspace_integrity_checker.py returned status STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE with exit code 0 and missing_required [] after target paths were set to ground-truth locations.
revisions.claim: Structural verification tools fail when assuming root-level conventional filenames rather than querying real workspace directory structures.
revisions.prediction: Explicitly mapping hardcoded target paths to real ground-truth locations would eliminate missing target flags and achieve STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE status.
revisions.test: Executed workspace_integrity_checker.py with corrected relative paths and top-indexed diagnostic JSON fields.
revisions.outcome: Tool ran successfully with zero missing targets, confirming full structural completeness.
revisions.revision: Verification tools must always be anchored against empirical directory listings captured by exploratory diagnostic tools rather than assumed file locations.
